question: List all patients with their sex and date of birthday, whose AST glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase (GOT) index is within normal range for loboratory examination in 1994.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "patient_lab_got" AS SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday, l.date AS lab_date, l.got FROM table_2 AS l JOIN table_1 AS p ON p.id = l.id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id, sex, birthday
    FROM patient_lab_got
    WHERE lab_date >= '1994-01-01' AND lab_date <= '1994-12-31'
      AND got BETWEEN 10 AND 40
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM eligible_patients
),
sample_patients AS (
    SELECT id, sex, birthday
    FROM eligible_patients
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 'summary' AS row_type, NULL AS id, NULL AS sex, NULL AS birthday, total_count, 'AST (GOT) normal range assumed 10-40 U/L inclusive; year=1994' AS note
FROM cnt
UNION ALL
SELECT 'patient' AS row_type, id, sex, birthday, NULL AS total_count, NULL AS note
FROM sample_patients;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id, sex, birthday
    FROM patient_lab_got
    WHERE lab_date >= '1994-01-01' AND lab_date <= '1994-12-31'
      AND got BETWEEN 10 AND 40
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM eligible_patients
),
patients AS (
    SELECT id, sex, birthday
    FROM eligible_patients
    ORDER BY id
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday, c.total_count, 'AST (GOT) normal range assumed 10-40 U/L inclusive; first 10 of all matches; year=1994' AS note
FROM patients p CROSS JOIN cnt c;
